newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta shares recover on selective buying.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta shares recover on selective buying.

text.p: Selective foreign buying helped the Jakarta share price index recover by the lunchbreak on Wednesday after earlier falling on profit-taking, brokers said.

The Jakarta Composite Index fell 0.25 percent, or 0.04 percent, to end the morning session at 656.41 points after rising to 656.89 points in the first few minutes of trading. It had reached a low of 654.53 points in mid-morning trading.
"It seems some foreign buyers started buying in selective blue-chip counters such as Bank Negara Indonesia, Indosat, Sampoerna," a broker with a Japanese firm said.

Brokers said foreign interest was also seen in medium-sized firms such as pharmaceutical-related shares, such as Kalbe Farma and Enseval. However, they said local investors remained the market's driving force.
"I don't expect much upside for the rest of the day even if foreign orders enter the market because local players are likely to cash out later," one local broker said.
Brokers said a fall of Telkom shares in New York overnight seemed to dampen market sentiment.
Telkom ADS closed at 34-1/2 in New York. In Jakarta, it fell 100 rupiah to 4,100 rupiah, with some two million shares traded.
Enseval and Dankos were active, possibly driven by sharp gains in Kalbe Farma in the last two days, brokers said.
Kalbe Farma fell back to 3,400 rupiah on 3.5 million shares after touching a high of 3,575 rupiah earlier on continued market talk of possible joint-ventures.
Brokers said investors took profit after making healthy gains in the last two days. They said it might also be linked to a denial from the company that it would form a joint-venture.
Enseval, the sister company and distributor of Kalbe Farma, rose 75 rupiah to 1,325 rupiah on 3.6 million shares on market talk that Kalbe would set up a joint-venture distribution firm.
Property and hotel firm Jakarta International rose 175 rupiah to 2,225 rupiah on 4.3 million shares following news that it was planning to issue 500 billion rupiah bonds.
